summary: Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completed acquisition of Ultra Electronics Advanced Tactical Systems, Inc. (Ultra I C Mission Solutions) via its wholly-owned subsidiary Booz Allen Hamilton Inc. The transaction closed on August 24, 2026, for $720 million in cash. Sellers were Ultra I C Holdings Limited and Ultra Electronics Holdings Limited. The acquired business will operate as the commercial product and solutions component of Booz Allen's defense technology business, enhancing its national security offerings. No advisors or board recommendation were disclosed. The deal has closed, so the risk-arb angle is moot; watch integration and contribution to Booz Allen's defense tech portfolio.
